details: Bitcoin's price has fallen below $63,000, experiencing a 1.14% drop in the last 24 hours. This decline is attributed to sustained selling pressure and $192 million in outflows from spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) over two consecutive days, effectively erasing gains from the previous week.
title: Bitcoin Price Dips Amid Selling Pressure and ETF Outflows

details: Morgan Stanley has reportedly increased its holdings in BlackRock's spot Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) by 23%. This move by a major institutional player signals growing confidence and continued institutional adoption of Bitcoin as a legitimate asset class.
title: Morgan Stanley Increases Stake in BlackRock Bitcoin ETF

details: Cboe BZX Exchange has submitted a filing to the SEC for approval to list the first-ever 3x leveraged Bitcoin and Ethereum futures Exchange-Traded Funds in the United States. If approved, these products would offer new, magnified trading opportunities for investors seeking exposure to BTC and ETH price movements.
title: Cboe Seeks SEC Approval for 3x Bitcoin and Ether ETFs

details: World Liberty Financial (WLFI) saw a 4.01% price surge after receiving conditional approval for a national trust bank charter from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) for its USD1 operations. This development signifies increasing regulatory acceptance and integration of digital assets into traditional finance.
title: World Liberty Financial Gains OCC Trust Bank Charter

details: Tether, the issuer of the USDT stablecoin, announced the successful completion of its first full independent audit of financial statements conducted by KPMG. This audit aims to bolster transparency and enhance confidence in the reserves backing the world's largest stablecoin.
title: Tether Completes First Full Independent Audit by KPMG

details: Bitcoin's hashrate has decreased by 17% from its all-time high, indicating a trend where some cryptocurrency miners are reallocating their computational resources and power away from Bitcoin mining and towards more lucrative artificial intelligence (AI) operations.
title: Bitcoin Hashrate Drops as Miners Shift Focus to AI

details: Former President Donald Trump is reportedly scheduled to meet with key leaders from Ripple, Coinbase, the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) to discuss the CLARITY Act. This meeting could be pivotal for future cryptocurrency regulation and market direction.
title: Trump to Meet with Ripple, Coinbase, SEC, and CFTC Leaders
